page.notes: The Gothic word in the line "adderetut" is set in black letter, transcribed as a best reading; the black-letter word is uncertain. Ornamental "ᴡeᴅᴇr-ȝɧᴅᴡ" is a doubtful reading of the Gothic vocable (likely "weder-zijds") [?]. Printed "cıo ıo" numerals are the reversed-C forms, transcribed as MDCLXXV and MDCLXXVI in intent but kept as printed here.
